content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Presets stripe

The architecture behind selling presets without Stripe is a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators in regions where conventional payment platforms fail. This approach provides a permanent solution that bypasses the limitations imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal. By embracing infrastructure sovereignty, creators can operate their online stores with autonomy, ensuring their financial independence in a volatile global economy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture employs a combination of free hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing. Utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend services, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions creates a seamless experience for both creators and buyers. The infrastructure ensures that transactions are secure and automatic, allowing for instant delivery of digital products right after purchase. Each component is designed to work together without reliance on centralized platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in countries facing payment limitations, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. These creators offer products like presets, templates, and courses but struggle to monetize due to the restrictions of conventional payment processors. By adopting this sovereign infrastructure, they can reclaim their ability to sell and deliver their products directly to their audience without the fear of account suspensions or fund holds.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system consists of multiple components: free hosting via Cloudflare Pages, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers, order storage with Supabase, and crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. Each element is chosen for its reliability and low cost, ensuring that creators can maintain their operations without ongoing fees or subscriptions. Moreover, full data ownership means that creators have complete control over their sales and customer data, reinforcing their sovereignty.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture, start by setting up a Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your digital storefront. Next, create backend logic using Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order data, and integrate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Once set up, you can load your products and begin selling instantly. This process can be completed within 48 hours, allowing you to start generating revenue without relying on restricted payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, consider using a sovereign commerce stack that utilizes free infrastructure and crypto payment processing. This setup allows you to sell digital products directly without dependence on traditional payment platforms. It means you can maintain full control over your sales and avoid the risks associated with account suspensions.
No KYC or account restrictions with crypto payments.

For those searching for alternatives to Gumroad or looking to sell digital products without a platform account, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust solution. Check out more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore how you can deploy this infrastructure and start selling today.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

You can sell digital products by deploying a sovereign commerce stack that uses free hosting and crypto payment processing. This setup enables you to operate without relying on payment processors like Stripe or PayPal.

The best alternative is to build your own commerce infrastructure using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to sell directly to customers without platform restrictions.

Using PayPal in these countries can be challenging, as account suspensions may occur and funds can be held for up to 180 days. It's better to explore alternatives like a sovereign commerce stack.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments in various digital currencies. This flexibility is crucial for creators in regions with limited access to traditional payment methods.
How can I ensure my data ownership is protected?

By using a sovereign commerce architecture, you maintain full control over your customer data and sales records. Unlike conventional platforms, this setup ensures that you own everything post-deployment.
